scope: Persisted tenant-admin Vendor CRUD, explicit private-origin configuration, secret-safe projections, and cross-tenant access denial in API and Cloud.

environment.database: Separate disposable PostgreSQL 16.15 databases for API and Cloud on localhost.
environment.fixtures: Synthetic tenant A and B admin accounts and Vendor rows only; all UAT-078 accounts and Vendor rows were deleted and verified absent.
environment.network: Only local HTTP services and the isolated PostgreSQL cluster; private destination URLs were stored as configuration and never contacted.

assertions_per_backend: Tenant A admin created a CRM Vendor configured with an explicitly allowed private RFC1918 origin.
Create, list, detail and update projections omitted raw username, password and API key values; the projection reported masked username and credential-presence booleans.
Updating the Vendor with masked placeholders preserved existing credential presence and changed the configured private origin and allowlist.
Tenant B admin created a separate Vendor on Tenant B's team.
Tenant A received 403 for Tenant B Vendor list, direct detail, update and delete, and for a forged create targeting Tenant B's team.
Both synthetic Vendors were deleted; database verification found zero UAT-078 users and Vendor rows.
limitations: This closes only the Vendor admin/API matrix row and tenant-isolation slice; other Vendor roles and Web behavior remain open.
No customer CRM or telephony provider was selected or contacted; each client's live integration acceptance remains separate.
